title: Mergepath Phase 4b automated-review verdict
description: Normalized verdict object that every Phase 4b reviewer adapter (codex / claude) must emit on stdout. Also passed verbatim to `codex exec --output-schema` so the Codex CLI constrains its final message to this shape. Strict (additionalProperties:false, all properties required) for OpenAI structured-output compatibility.

verdict.description: The reviewer's merge decision. APPROVED becomes a `gh pr review --approve` (the Phase 4b substitute clearance the merge gate accepts); CHANGES_REQUESTED becomes `gh pr review --request-changes`. There is deliberately no COMMENTED/abstain value: an adapter that cannot reach one of these two decisions must exit non-zero so the orchestrator fails closed to the manual handoff rather than posting an ambiguous review.

summary.description: One to four sentences explaining the verdict. Posted as the review body.

findings.description: Per-issue findings. Empty array is valid (a clean APPROVED). For CHANGES_REQUESTED there should be at least one P0/P1 finding.

severity.description: P0/P1 block clearance; P2/P3 are advisory (mirrors the Codex GitHub App priority markers).

path.description: Repo-relative file path the finding anchors to, or null for a PR-level finding.

line.description: 1-based line in the new file, or null.
